minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  August 11, 2020

  The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
  on Tuesday, August 11, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority and Joint
  Powers Authority at the hour of 2:05p.m.

  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Joint Powers
  Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Joint
  Powers Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members/Joint Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority /Joint Powers Authority officials and
  personnel present were as follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority and Joint Powers
  Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Joint Powers
  Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
  address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Joint
  Powers Authority on any item on the Agenda.

  No name given spoke concerning the Warrant Register, and Agenda Item No., CI-1.

219  JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY TREASURER – MONTHLY TREASURER’S
  REPORT. Staff report dated August 11, 2020, was presented submitting the Monthly
  Treasurer’s Report for the Month ending April 30, 2020.

  Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts ordered the report received and filed.

  There being no further business to be presented, Housing Authority Chairman Butts
  adjourned the meeting in memory of Desiree Cromo, District 2 resident, and the
  celebration of Life for Leonardo Andreas, at the hour of 2:55 p.m.

  Approved this 16th day of March, 2021.

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
